label: Refuse every UPDATE and DELETE of a V2Event row

execute.description: Create v2.V2Event_append_only() raising on any row mutation
execute.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "v2"."V2Event_append_only"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'V2Event is append-only: % refused for thread % seq %', TG_OP, OLD."threadId", OLD."seq"
    USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';
END;
$$

execute.description: Create the BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE row trigger on V2Event
execute.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "V2Event_append_only"
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "v2"."V2Event"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "v2"."V2Event_append_only"()
